title: My night room tour showed something under the bed 🛏️
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark moody blue-teal grade, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, realistic, no text, no watermark, no faces
hook_text: At 2:51 a.m. my room tour showed something under the bed.

scenes.narration: At 2:51 a.m. my room tour showed something under the bed.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom bed with a deep shadow under it, phone light on the floor, no person

scenes.narration: I do late night room tours for my followers. Cozy lamp. Soft music. Slow pan across the room. Nothing weird. Ever.

shots.prompt: cozy bedroom with a warm lamp at night, soft light, bed and shelf, no person

scenes.narration: This time, I panned past the bed and the audio crackled. Like someone breathing in, very slowly.

shots.prompt: low angle view of a bedroom floor and bed frame, warm lamp light, no person

scenes.narration: I lowered the camera to the floor. Under the bed, the dark was thick. Too thick. It did not move with my light.

shots.prompt: flashlight beam on the floor under a bed, deep black shadow, no person

scenes.narration: My slipper was next to the bed. I looked at it. I looked back at the camera. The slipper had moved six inches.

shots.prompt: single slipper on a wooden floor beside a bed, flashlight beam, no person

scenes.narration: I held my breath. The slipper slid across the floor. Slowly. Into the dark. No hand. No pull. Just gone.

shots.prompt: wooden floor under a bed with a faint drag mark in the dust, dark, no person

scenes.narration: The lamp flickered. Under the bed, something exhaled. I heard it through the phone and through the room at the same time.

shots.prompt: bedroom with a flickering lamp and a dark gap under the bed, no person

scenes.narration: I ended the stream. The chat was full. Everyone was typing the same thing. Check your feet.

shots.prompt: phone on a bedspread with a bright screen glow, dark room, no text

scenes.narration: I looked down. My other slipper was still on my foot. And it was already half in the dark.

shots.prompt: dark floor beside a bed, a slipper at the edge of deep shadow, no person

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you check under the bed, or leave the room?

shots.prompt: dark bedroom bed with a deep shadow under it, phone light on the floor, no person
